reason: Re-opened via packet.js tao 11: Wang Bi comments on exactly 三十輻共一轂，當其無，有車之用 with 轂所以能統三十輻者，無也，以其無能受物之故，故能以實統眾也. The nave uniting the spokes by non-being, its non-being receiving things, and so holding the many together are all his. The paraphrase omits 以實 (by its substance; some editions read 以寡, the few) and so claims nothing the text does not carry. Plain sense faithful and avoids Legge’s parenthesis (for the axle). verse.js ok (at [10]); entry-check ok; 54 words, one semicolon. No school, comparison or tone issue.
